# Trueline IT

> Done-for-you AI receptionist and Google review requests for trades and contractors, and for salons, clinics and studios. Trades and contractors also get missed-call text-back, quote follow-up, chat-to-text, text-to-pay and contractor websites. Plus AI governance for professional firms. We set it up and run it. Call (647) 360-5774 for trades, contractor, salon and studio services.

## Trades and contractor services (call-only)
Call (647) 360-5774. No forms on these services.
- Missed-Call Text-Back: $149/mo per location plus a one-time $199 setup. When you miss a call, the caller gets a text within minutes, the thread captures what they need, and you're alerted. Works on your existing number. https://truelineit.com/missed-call-text-back
- AI Receptionist: $399/mo plus a one-time $499 setup. Answers calls nights, weekends and after hours, captures job requests and flags urgent calls to you. https://truelineit.com/ai-receptionist
- Quote Follow-Up & Win-Back: $149/mo per location plus $199 setup. https://truelineit.com/quote-follow-up-win-back
- Website Chat-to-Text: $79/mo per location plus $99 setup. https://truelineit.com/website-chat-to-text
- Text-to-Pay Invoices: $49/mo per location plus $99 setup. https://truelineit.com/text-to-pay
- Contractor Websites: $499/mo, no setup fee. Done-for-you site, live within a week. https://truelineit.com/contractor-websites
- Google Reviews (one service, two plans, per location): Requests $79/mo plus $99 setup; Requests + Replies $99/mo plus $99 setup. Replies is a +$20/mo upgrade, not sold on its own. https://truelineit.com/google-review-requests

Month-to-month, cancel anytime. 30-day money-back guarantee on monthly services: if it's not right within 30 days of your first invoice and first payment, we refund your entire first invoice — the setup fee plus your first month — no questions asked.

## AI governance ladder (forms)
For law firms, accountants and advisors that want to use AI safely, done for you: written AI use policies, checks for unapproved AI tools, Microsoft 365 Copilot setup, and staff training. Set up with PIPEDA in mind. This is guidance and setup, not legal advice. The ladder starts at the $1,000 AI Liability Assessment.
- AI Liability Assessment: $1,000, credited in full toward a retainer if you continue within 90 days. First step of the ladder. https://truelineit.com/fractional-ai-officer#assessment
- Fractional AI Officer: $10,000–25,000/mo. Cancel anytime. No notice period. https://truelineit.com/fractional-ai-officer
- AI Support Agent: $2,000 setup + $500/mo. https://truelineit.com/ai-support-agent
- Hub: https://truelineit.com/for-law-firms-accountants-and-advisors
- Governance overview: https://truelineit.com/ai-governance
